# Whole-workspace duplicate-implementation inventory — jka-rust

Merged and deduplicated from 49 reader slices (`reports/slice_00.md` … `slice_48.md`),
covering all 2,866 files / 481k lines under `crates/`. Each entry is one *logical*
cluster (many were independently found by 2–6 readers); the per-slice detail lives in
the reports directory. File paths are absolute-relative to the repo root
`/Users/milohehmsoth/Developer/Milo/jka-rust`.

Mechanical census backing this sweep: **11,464 fns body-hashed → 198 exact-body clusters
across 451 sites; 142 name-drift (same-name/different-body) groups.** The readers
adjudicated every precomputed collision plus did within-file (a)/(c) and blatant-type (d)
passes.

Legend: **EXACT-COPY** = byte-identical body · **SEMANTIC-DUP** = same behavior, different
text · **DIVERGENT** = same intent, *different behavior* (correctness risk) · **TWIN** =
SP/MP ABI pair · **SHARED-DUP** = crosses crate tiers · **SAME-SIDE** = MP-only (or
same-crate).

---

## 1. Correctness risks — copies that BEHAVE differently (ACTION ITEMS, ranked)

These are the only entries where the duplicates diverge in observable behavior. Ranked by
severity.

### 1.1 — HIGH — `f32`-vs-`f64` sqrt divergence in hand-rolled `VectorLength`/`VectorNormalize`
The canonical `native_math::qmath::VectorLength` (`crates/native/math/src/qmath.rs:235`)
and `VectorNormalize` (`qmath.rs:891`) deliberately sum→cast-to-`f64`→`sqrt()`→cast-back to
match Raven's `(vec_t)sqrt(double)` — the doc comment explicitly warns a plain `f32::sqrt()`
double-rounds and diverges from the oracle. At least **8 local copies use plain `f32::sqrt()`
and silently reintroduce the bug the centralized version already fixed**:
- `crates/mp/engine/server/src/sv_world.rs:73` (`VectorLength`)
- `crates/mp/game/src/g_client.rs:107` (`VectorLength`, byte-identical to sv_world's)
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/render/bone_transform.rs:174` (`vector_length3`)
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/render/skeleton.rs:167,290,300` (`vector_normalize_row`/`vector_normalize`/`vector_normalize2`)
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/api_bolts.rs:393` (`vector_normalize_row`)
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/ragdoll.rs:378` (`vector_normalize`)
- `crates/mp/engine/qcommon/src/cm_patch.rs:109-122` (`vector_normalize`)

Evidence: `sv_world.rs`/`g_client.rs` bodies are `(v0*v0+v1*v1+v2*v2).sqrt()`; qmath casts to
f64 first. The sibling `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/render/bone_cache.rs:43` *does* import the
canonical `mp_qshared::shared::VectorNormalize`, proving the "no reachable q_math port" claim
in skeleton.rs/api_bolts.rs doc comments is factually stale within their own crate. Used on
distance-sorting spawn selection (`SelectNearestDeathmatchSpawnPoint`,
`SelectRandomFurthestSpawnPoint`, `SelectDuelSpawnPoint`) and collision link code.
*Slices: 9, 13, 31, 35, 39, 40.*

### 1.2 — HIGH — `f32`-vs-`f64` trig divergence in ghoul2 `vectoangles`/`AngleVectors`/`AnglesToAxis`
`native_math::qmath::vectoangles` (`qmath.rs:604`), `AngleVectors` (`qmath.rs:1034`) and
`AnglesToAxis` (`qmath.rs:643`) promote `atan2`/`sin`/`cos`/`sqrt` to `f64` before casting to
`f32` (matching Raven's double libm — this is exactly the "1-ULP angle findings / promote-to-
double libm macros" the project already fixed once in the referee-oracle pass). Two ghoul2
copies compute **entirely in `f32`** and DIVERGE:
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/ragdoll.rs:393,420` (`angle_vectors`, `vectoangles`) + `:353-462`
- `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/misc.rs:429` (`angle_vectors`)

Contrast: the sibling copies in `crates/mp/engine/ghoul2/src/bones.rs:236` and
`crates/mp/engine/qcommon/src/roff/roff_system.rs:947` correctly f64-promote (their doc
comments say so). So the divergence is specifically misc.rs/ragdoll.rs. *Slices: 26, 39, 40.*

### 1.3 — HIGH — `ON_EPSILON` wrong-constant import (genuine bug)
`crates/mp/engine/botlib/src/be_aas_sample/be_aas_sample_fns.rs:31` imports `ON_EPSILON` from
`crate::be_aas_bspq3::be_aas_bspq3_cpp_consts::ON_EPSILON = 0.005` — a *different* oracle macro
(`be_aas_bspq3.cpp:30`) — instead of the file's own correct
`be_aas_sample_cpp_consts::ON_EPSILON = 0.0` (`be_aas_sample.cpp:36`). `AAS_TraceClientBBox`
(`be_aas_sample_fns.rs:1212,1227`) therefore uses `0.005` where the oracle uses `0` at
`be_aas_sample.cpp:623,637`; the correct file-local const is dead code. *Slice: 13.*

### 1.4 — MEDIUM — lossy-UTF8 local string helpers in `common_fns.rs` (latent correctness bug)
`crates/mp/engine/qcommon/src/common_fns.rs:2038-2093` defines local `q_stricmp`,
`q_stricmpn`, `q_strcmp`, `q_strncpyz`, `to_upper`, `com_default_extension` that convert
through `CStr::to_string_lossy()` (substituting U+FFFD) **before** comparing/copying, whereas
the canonical `mp_qshared::shared::q_string::{Q_stricmp,…}` compare raw bytes. On non-UTF-8
filenames/console tokens this can make byte-distinct strings compare equal (or vice versa).
Live callers routing through the lossy locals: `Com_SafeMode`, `Com_StartupVariable`,
`Com_AddStartupCommands`, `Com_WriteConfig_f`. The same file already imports and uses the
byte-exact shared versions elsewhere. *Slice: 25.*

### 1.5 — MEDIUM — `BG_AnimLength` method-vs-free-fn bounds-check gap
`crates/mp/bg/src/bg_panimate.rs`: the free-fn form (`:1818`) has an out-of-range guard
`if (index as usize) >= bg_state.bgAllAnims.len() { return -1; }` (`:1832`); the
`PmoveContext` method form (`:1804`) indexes `self.bg.bgAllAnims[index as usize]` directly
(`:1810`) with **no guard**, so an out-of-range `index` panics through the method path but
returns `-1` through the free-fn path. Raven has one un-guarded function; the guard was added
during the method/free-fn split, creating an inconsistency between "the same" function's two
forms. *Slice: 43.*

### 1.6 — LOW — `c_atoi` overflow-semantics mismatch across 3 copies
`crates/mp/engine/icarus/src/q3_interface/mod.rs:165` delegates to `str::parse::<i32>()`
(returns **0** on overflow), while `crates/mp/engine/qcommon/src/stringed/package.rs:31` and
`crates/mp/host-interface/src/mock.rs:85` hand-roll C's **wrapping-truncate** overflow. Same
skip-ws/sign/digit-run front end, different tail behavior on overflow inputs. Needs a decision
(is the divergence deliberate per site?) before any merge, not a mechanical fix. *Slices: 23, 28, 29.*

**Category 1 total: 6 distinct correctness clusters.**

## 3. SP/MP byte-identical twins — `native/` hoisting candidates (lowest urgency)

Genuine SP/MP twins with **zero per-mode divergence** (unlike the deliberately-divergent ABI
twins in Category 6). Under the current homogenization push these are the class most like
what q_math/rng already became.

1. **`animNumber_t` ~1800-line enum** — `crates/mp/bg/src/public/anim_number.rs` vs
   `crates/sp/bg/src/public/anim_number.rs`; all 1544 variant lines diffed byte-identical
   (largest single twin in the sweep). *Slice: 4.*
2. **`animEventType_t` / `footstepType_t`** — mp/sp `bg/src/public/{anim_event_type,footstep_type}.rs`,
   enum bodies byte-identical. *Slice: 4.*
3. **`vmCvar_t` + `vmCvar_t::zeroed`** — `crates/mp/qshared/src/shared/cvar.rs:120` byte-identical
   to `crates/sp/qshared/src/shared/cvar.rs:87`; the struct itself (272 B) is identical (unlike
   `cvar_t`, which genuinely diverges on `hashNext`). *Slices: 7, 43, 44.*
4. **RMG `symmetry_t` / `ERMDir`** — mp/sp `engine/rmg/src/rm_headers/symmetry_t.rs` and
   `rm_path/ermdir.rs`, byte-identical `#[repr(i32)]` enums, no client/server boundary. *Slice: 47.*
5. **MP3-decoder / sound vendor types** — byte-identical across mp/sp client crates:
   `IN_OUT`, `SAMPLE`, `MP3STREAM`/`_L1_2`/`_L3`/`_u` (~200 lines incl. asserts), `id3v1_1`,
   `wavinfo_t`, `portable_samplepair_t`, `STREAMINGBUFFER`, `SoundCompressionMethod_t`, `dma_t`,
   `ambientSet_s`, `set_e`/`setKeyword_e`, `SBT_FUNCTION`/`XFORM_FUNCTION`. Vendor decoder structs
   with no gameplay divergence. (Exception: `DECODE_FUNCTION` genuinely differs — leave.) *Slice: 45.*
6. **Small cgame types** — `clightstyle_t`, `markPoly_t` (+`MAX_VERTS_ON_POLY`), `powerupInfo_t`,
   `leFlag_t`, `footstep_t` — byte-identical mp/sp `cgame/src/{lights,local,media}/*`. *Slice: 46.*
7. **Client twins `console_t` / `kbutton_t` / `field_t`** — byte-identical mp/sp
   `engine/client/src/{client,keys}/*`. *Slice: 45.*
8. **`modInfo_t` / `playerSpeciesInfo_t`** — byte-identical mp/sp `ui/src/local/*`. *Slice: 31.*
9. **`qboolean` double-definition inside `native` itself** —
   `crates/native/types/src/lib.rs:31` and `crates/native/math/src/qmath.rs:14` both declare
   `pub type qboolean = c_int;` independently (native_math doesn't even depend on native_types).
   Highest-confidence, lowest-effort. *Slice: 11.*
10. **`byte` / `clipHandle_t` redeclarations** — canonical `native_types::{byte,clipHandle_t}`
    re-declared at `crates/mp/game/src/prelude.rs:28`, `crates/mp/bg/src/prelude.rs:19` (byte),
    `crates/sp/abi/src/cgame/types.rs:10` (clipHandle_t). *Slice: 11.*
11. **`saying_t`** — mp/sp `game/src/say/saying_t.rs`, identical 17-variant enum from identical
    oracle headers. *Slice: 5.*
12. **`FILE` opaque stub** — byte-identical `crates/{mp,sp}/engine/icarus/src/blockstream/file.rs`
    (`#[repr(C)] struct FILE { _opaque:[u8;0] }`), never instantiated. *Slice: 23.*
13. **uishared type twins (7 byte-identical)** — `rectDef_t`, `colorRangeDef_t`, `columnInfo_s`,
    `commandDef_t`, `editFieldDef_s`, `listBoxDef_s`, `textScrollDef_s` across mp/sp
    `uishared/src/shared/*` (the other 7 in that dir genuinely diverge — leave those). *Slice: 32.*
14. **`CMiniHeap`** — mp/sp `engine/qcommon/src/miniheap/cmini_heap.rs` (minor pub/cfg
    inconsistency only). *Slice: 9.*
15. **GP2 tokenizer** — `Tokenizer::get_token`/`MAX_TOKEN_SIZE` byte-identical mp/sp
    (`gp2/tokenizer.rs`), the one GP2 component with no per-mode behavior (rest of GP2 is an
    intentional twin — see Category 6). *Slices: 43, 47.*
16. **`mapVert_t` / `drawVert_t`** — Raven's own within-side identical-shape pair (80 B), present
    in both mp and sp qfiles; kept separate per naming rules. Low value. *Slices: 23, 37.*

**Category 3 total: 16 distinct twin clusters.**

## 4. Test-support duplication

1. **Parity golden helpers `compare()` / `oracle_dir()` / `oracle_root()`** — `fn compare` (23-line
   byte-diff-and-panic) copy-pasted verbatim in all 7 `crates/mp/game/tests/*_parity.rs`
   (`wsaber`, `gcombat`, `bgmisc`, `pmove`, `pmove_saber`, `qshared`, `jampgame`); `oracle_root()`
   independently redefined in ~8–10 `*_parity.rs` across mp engine crates (`ghoul2_server`,
   `matcomp`, `icarus`, `roff`, `stringed`, `rmg_terrain`, `npcnav`, `tr_model`). Extract to a
   shared `tests/support` module. *Slices: 17, 23, 45, 47, 48.*
2. **`pmove_parity.rs` ≈ `pmove_saber_parity.rs` harness (~700 lines)** — byte-identical
   `zero_trace`/`brush_plane`/`clip_box_to_brush`/`trace_world`/`point_in_brushes`, the whole
   `struct TestTraps + impl BgTraps` (~280 lines), `struct TestCallbacks + impl GameCallbacks`
   (~160 lines), `parse_scenario`; only `ps_baseline`/`apply_ps_override`/`dump_step`/scenarios
   differ (saber adds a few ps fields). Single largest test dup. *Slice: 45.*
3. **`TestTraps` / `TestCallbacks` fixture ×3** — `crates/mp/game/tests/{pmove_parity,
   pmove_saber_parity,jampgame_parity}.rs` each carry a near-identical `BgTraps` VFS mock
   (`files: RefCell<Vec<…>>`, fs open/read/close, trace-via-brushes). *Slices: 28, 45.*
4. **`fixture_host` / `seed_dir`** — recursive fixture-loader duplicated
   `crates/mp/renderer/tests/tr_model_parity.rs:65,72` ↔ `qcommon/tests/stringed_parity.rs:44,53`
   (and likely more suites). *Slices: 17, 47.*
5. **referee `FieldTable`/`field_at`/`describe`/PS/FD/ES/TR tables** — byte-identical
   `crates/jampgame/tests/referee.rs:99-214` and
   `crates/mp/engine/server/src/sv_referee_fields.rs:14-136` (intent to share was documented,
   code was copy-pasted; drift risk since the offset tables must stay in lockstep). *Slices: 35, 44.*
6. **gp2 dump helpers** — `dump_group`/`dump_in_order`/`dump` byte-identical
   `crates/sp/qshared/tests/gp2_parity.rs:14,39,49` ↔ `crates/mp/engine/qcommon/tests/gp2_parity.rs`.
   *Slices: 12, 47.*
7. **`pi`/`pf` token parsers + `zero_trace`/`snap_vector` test doubles** — hex-or-decimal token
   parsers duplicated across the 7 parity files; `snap_vector` (`round_ties_even`) re-derived in 3
   test mocks instead of calling `mp_bg::bg_misc::snap_vector`; `zero_trace` in 2 test files.
   *Slices: 39, 43, 45.*

## 6. Systemic false-positive patterns (for future sweeps)

These generate the bulk of name-collision noise; recognizing them up front saves adjudication.

1. **`trap.rs` outbound syscall shims vs engine-side impls** — `crates/mp/game/src/trap.rs` is
   generated (`fngen.py`); every fn is `<Engine as Execute<X>>::execute(engine, args)`, the
   client stub for a Raven `trap_X` whose real impl lives in botlib/qcommon/ghoul2. Same Raven
   name, opposite sides of the VM boundary. Applies to ~all `AAS_*`/`Bot*`/`EA_*`/`Cvar_*`/`FS_*`/
   `G2API_*` collisions. *Slices 5, 22, 25, 27, 31, 32, 36, 39, 45, 47.*
2. **Q3_* ICARUS seam pairs** — `g_ICARUScb.rs` (game-side vmcall handler) vs
   `icarus/q3_interface/mod.rs` (engine-side marshaller); Raven names both ends identically.
   15 `Q3_*` collisions. *Slices 8, 23.*
3. **Per-vehicle vtable dispatch** — `Board`/`Update`/`Eject`/`ProcessMoveCommands`/`AnimateVehicle`/
   `RegisterAssets`/… across `SpeederNPC`/`WalkerNPC`/`AnimalNPC`/`FighterNPC`/`g_vehicles.rs`;
   Raven's `vehicleInfo_t` fn-ptr table, each class overriding or call-through to the base body.
   Genuinely different bodies. *Slices 24, 29, 37.*
4. **Trait / mock / impl triads** — `EngineHost` (real `EngineHostView` + `MockHost` +
   `&mut T` blanket forwarder), `BgTraps`/`GameCallbacks` (production `GameBgTraps`/`GameCallbacksImpl`
   + `TestTraps`/`TestCallbacks`). ~50 method-name collisions per family, all intended
   real-vs-double / real-vs-hook polymorphism. *Slices 13, 28, 39, 45, 47.*
5. **Generic-verb method collisions** — `zeroed`/`init`/`create`/`clear`/`free`/`get`/`get_mut`/
   `insert`/`remove`/`add`/`save`/`load`/`restart`/`update`/`from`/`as_ptr`/`range`/`check`/`snapshot`/
   `open`/`play`/`route` on unrelated ported C++ classes (ICARUS/ghoul2/npcnav/stringed/GP2/roff)
   and ABI-arg getters. Raven's own OO vocabulary repeating across one-class-per-file ports.
   *Nearly every slice.*
6. **UI syscall trampolines with leaked `Cg`/`G`-prefixed struct names** — 18 files in
   `crates/mp/abi/src/ui/syscalls/*.rs` (e.g. `UI_ARGC.rs:17` names its struct `CgArgcArgs`)
   were authored by copy-pasting the cgame/game sibling and forgetting to rename to `Ui*`. Correct
   ABI binding, but a **naming-hygiene defect** — mechanical rename recommended. *Slice 3.*
7. **ABI one-token-per-file boilerplate** — `crates/{mp,sp}/abi/src/{cgame,game,ui}/{syscalls,vmcalls}/*.rs`
   (~1000 files): each is a distinct Raven trap/vmMain token with its own `Args`+encode/decode.
   Mechanically repetitive by convention (`sweep.py`/`port-wave` codegen); a declarative macro
   (`syscall_no_args!`/`syscall_one_float!`) could collapse the ~zero-arg / single-float / opaque-ptr
   families but that's a style choice, not a defect. *Slices 2, 3, 5, 6, 30, 42, 48.*
8. **`G_TESTPRINTFLOAT`/`G_TESTPRINTINT` UI/G/CGAME triplets** — same-shape shims differing only in
   `Import` type + doc cite; instance of #7. *Slice 48.*
9. **`install_engine_hooks` per-tier** — server/renderer each fill disjoint `EngineHooks` fields;
   `core::host_view` orchestrates both. Intended composition. *Slices 13, 22, 33.*
10. **`mapVert_t`/`drawVert_t`, `refexport_t`/`render_command_t` twins, `From` impls,
    SP/MP ABI structs that genuinely diverge** — same-name/different-layout ABI twins are the
    *intended* convention, not duplication (distinguish from Category 3's zero-divergence twins).
    *Slices 4, 16, 23, 31, 32, 34, 37, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48.*

**Category 6 total: 10 systemic false-positive patterns.**
